single.rationale: Vail Resorts faces structural headwinds including declining skier visits (down 3% in FY2025), deteriorating cash generation (operating cash flow down from $710M to $555M over three years), and rising leverage (debt increased to $3.2B while equity shrank to $425M). While the pass model provides revenue visibility, early indicators show concerning trends with 3% unit decline in 2025/2026 pass sales and meaningful operating margin compression from 24% to 19% over three years, suggesting pricing power limitations and structural cost pressures that warrant monitoring before deeper engagement.
